---
name: Formalization contribution
about: Offer an independent formal proof or related formalization work.
title: "[Formalization] "
---

Independent contributions are welcome. An issue can describe a proposed or
existing contribution; it does not imply that a formal proof already exists.

## Version

Repository commit or release, manuscript title, and source or PDF hash if available:

## Theorem, equation, or proof step

Identify the statement, assumptions, and precise portion to formalize:

## Contribution details

Describe the intended or completed work, proof assistant and version if
known, dependencies, and a link or minimal example if available. Identify any
remaining axioms, unproved lemmas, or checks needed.
